datasets.name: Thebe expert-labelled field seismic dataset
datasets.citation: An et al., A gigabyte interpreted seismic dataset for automatic fault recognition, 2021
datasets.usage_boundary: The volume and expert labels must be sliced at identical coordinates. Compute a fault attribute from seismic; never use the label itself as input. Labels focus on interpreted faults and are not guaranteed to include every subtle response.

datasets.name: F3 Netherlands 3D seismic survey
datasets.license: CC BY-SA; verify the selected distribution terms
datasets.citation: Netherlands Offshore F3 Block, Dutch Government/TNO and dGB Earth Sciences
datasets.usage_boundary: Generate horizon or time-slice similarity/coherency attributes. Quantitative geological accuracy requires an independent local interpretation; unlabelled visual review alone is not precision or recall evidence.

datasets.name: Penobscot 3D seismic survey
datasets.license: Public access subject to CNSOPB/CNSOER data terms
datasets.citation: Penobscot 3D survey NS24-N011-001E, offshore Nova Scotia
datasets.usage_boundary: Registration may be required. Use as an independent survey and preserve SEG-Y geometry; do not claim labelled accuracy without a separately documented interpretation.

datasets.name: CRACKS subsurface fault delineation dataset
datasets.citation: Prabhushankar et al., CRACKS: Crowdsourcing Resources for Analysis and Categorization of Key Subsurface faults, 2024
datasets.usage_boundary: Images are vertical F3 seismic sections, not planar fault-attribute maps. Use for auxiliary boundary and annotation uncertainty studies, not as direct contest-format evidence.

datasets.name: FaultSeg3D synthetic seismic and fault labels
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; research and non-commercial use
datasets.usage_boundary: Synthetic labels provide exact controlled truth but do not prove field-data generalization. Use held-out geometries and separate real surveys for final evidence.
